content:
Vik (Partnerships): Heads-up team  Orchid Analytics has renewed and expanded: 4yr renewal, migrating from Hosted -> Dedicated + Redwood Private VPC, and we got an ISV listing on IBM Cloud Catalog. Public case study + joint webinar planned next month. :tada:
Anya (Account Exec): Incredible outcome  they've been with Hosted for 18 months. Key ask was data residency + audit logs for EU financial customers. Who will grab the customer quote and logo?
Zoe (Marketing): I'll own the case study. Need: short quote (<= 120 chars), 2-sentence customer profile, high-res logo, and a 30s CTO clip by EOD next Tue to hit our editorial calendar.
Ravi (Solutions): Infra notes: provisioned Dedicated GPU pool in eu-gb1, pinned model to `rwd-mistral-14b-quant`, enabled Dedicated-first routing with Hosted fallback, KV cache prefill scheduled during low-traffic window. We'll enable per-request audit logging to their KMS and set p95 alert at 220ms.
Kellen (Finance): Contract signed  4yr committed ARR $2.4M. PO confirmed, revenue schedule on contract. Includes premium SLAs and SOC2 addendum. Billing contact: invoices@orchid-analytics.com.
Vik (Partnerships): Orchid legal approved this quote: "Redwood gave us private, auditable inference at scale  exactly what we needed for regulated models." They also approved co-branded social and a joint webinar. Assets to be uploaded to `/partners/orchid_analytics/`
IndexBot: IBM Cloud Catalog listing published: https://cloud.ibm.com/catalog/listing/orchid-analytics-redwood (listing id: ibm-0xE3F). Indexing/propagation may take up to 30 mins.
Anya (Account Exec): Great. CS kickoff scheduled for next Wed. Also scheduling exec briefing with Orchid's CTO for the webinar.
Ravi (Solutions): Launch checklist: 1) KV warm 2) perf smoke in eu-gb1 3) canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 hours 4) validate audit log delivery to KMS 5) run e2e sample latency tests. I'll post perf numbers after the smoke run.
OnboardBot: Onboarding ticket ONB-11024 created; SRE runbook and SOC2 checklist attached.
Zoe (Marketing): Draft case study & social copy uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/orchid-case-study.md. Please add legal redlines ASAP. Will queue social the day of webinar.
Kellen (Finance): Note: this deal converted to Dedicated with an upfront commitment; please route any scope change requests through finance.
Vik (Partnerships): Assigning owners: @Zoe - case study + comms; @Ravi - perf + CTO clip; @Kellen - billing verification; @Anya - CS kickoff & webinar coordination. Closing thread once IBM listing indexing confirmed. Huge team effort! :rocket:
